Bone vec3: equal to /9[]/9 everywhere; on field maps it is a world-space point near the bone group (bbox centre?). Not read: meshes are already in world space.

WP 2.5d (field.py field_blend -> material extras.fieldBlend, layers as glTF texture refs + PNGs beside the FBX). colour = lerp(under, over, mask.a) * mask.rgb, under = base or lerp(base, base2, noise.r | vertex alpha), over = lerp(over[0], over[1], noise.r). Cliff/rock (BorderTex): over = GroundTex01/02 (UV Tex00_UV), noise = BlendTex, mask = BorderTex on UV GroundBlend (2): mask alpha ~1 on cliff tops, ~0.3 on faces (area02 cliffs, V flipped). Ground (GrassTex01): base2 = GroundTex02, over = GrassTex01/02, noise = GrassBlendTex, mask = BlendTex on UV_tex02 (2): alpha 0.94 over Pallet's main lawn = grass. Lawn (green_blend): base2 = TextureMap02 by green_blend; cut-out = green_hikari alpha on UVSet01 (1) at DiscardValuie when DiscardEnable (inside at ~75% of card centroids, outside at edge vertices), else opacity when blended (rockmask01); alpha01 on UV0 (FieldGrassShader05); light_line / FieldGrassShader04 Texture03 = scrolling highlight. Roofs (TexBlendType 1 + VertexColor): base2 = Texture02 by vertex alpha (kept in COLOR_0). Noise scale/contrast and the roof gain are FITTED in the UE masters (PokeKanto poke_asset_common FIELD_PARAMS, ROOF_BLEND_GAIN).

Vertex RGB on non-tree field meshes = baked light/shadow tint (white..teal (46,123,110), the teal also on whole background plateaus), exported as COLOR_0 multiplier. Tree shaders: RGB ~0 with varying alpha = data (wind/ramp weight), dropped. A primitive whose RGB is all 0 (sea rocks) is treated as unpainted. Alpha kept only on BLEND materials (water/wave shore fade).

FieldTreeShader04/05: Texture02 is a vertical ramp (W x 4W) addressed by UV UVSet01 (1), whose V follows crown height (corr 0.90-0.98) and the up-facing normal (0.96) on area02 trees, so it is a painted height ramp, not a lighting lookup. Base colour still bakes Texture03 x the ramp alpha-weighted mean (fallback); extras.fieldRamp = {leaf Texture03, ramp Texture02 (UV1), silhouette Texture01}: colour = lerp(silhouette, leaf x ramp, ramp.a + bias) with bias 0.35 FITTED in UE. Pines (FieldTreeShader02, field:treeLightAdd) differ.

FieldWaterShader01 has no albedo: base = Base_Color1, opacity 0.75 FITTED (glTF fallback). WP 2.5d extras.fieldWater: net = WaterNetTex01/02 (white caustic lines, tinted WaterNetTex0N_Color), light = WaterLightTex01/02 (big blobs), sky = sky_tex (horizon gradient), colors = Base_Color1/2, UV 'UV' (0; tiles every 6 m on sea_00). Static tex0N_U/V are 0, so the scroll is animated in game: UE drifts are FITTED. FieldWaterShader02 (shore foam): foam = Texture01/02 (scalloped band in alpha) with TexNN_Translate offsets. Opacity = vertex alpha (0.5-0.9 sea, 0.3-0.6 foam). NormalMap unused.

FieldWindowShader: colour = screen(Color01, TextureMap01) = Color01 + (1 - Color01) x tex, opaque (WP 2.5d; was saturate(Color01 + tex), which turned the Mart window and door, mask 0.25-0.8, white). Same as the sum for dark inputs: house windows (pale blue + dark grey mask), Center/Gym door glass (near-black + logo). Color02, Min/Max/Intensity, LightProjMap (cloud01 projection), Shadow_Color and OnGameColor not drawn.

FieldTreeShader02 (pines, 97 materials, all Texture01 + Texture02 + DirlightColor): Texture01 is pre-shaded colour with purple-grey shade under each tier, Texture02 a grey light mask (0.6 default, white tips, black under tiers). Drawn alone the shade reads navy; extras.fieldBlend base2By 'lightAdd': colour += Texture02 x DirlightColor (gain 1.5 FITTED in UE). treelighttable/shadowtable toon ramps, GreenColor, RimColor, rimColor02 not drawn.

Field material params not read: lightColor/RimColor/Shadow_Color/rimColor02/DirlightColor/GreenColor, RimLight_*, Shadow_Min/Max/Strangth, ShadowBias/ShadowSampingScale, LightProjMap* (cloud shadow projection), ParallaxScale*, Camera_Light, LightDir_Min/Max, Light_Power, Alpha_light, Transparent (1.0 on opaque materials), OnGameColor/OnGameAlpha, scroll_U/V, Emission_UV, Reflection_*; texture slots ShadowToonTable/lightToonTable (toon ramps), HighlightMap, NormalMap, ParallaxMap, Reflection_tex, DepthBuffer.
